basics.name: Lauri Hakola
basics.label: Fullstack Developer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer and true techie with deep backend, data and DevOps strength. Lauri dives into difficult technical challenges, designs systems for demanding requirements, and is especially strong at getting troubled projects back on track. He has worked across pension technology, energy, media, healthcare, gaming, telecom, startups and the public sector, and can also contribute in modern frontend stacks when needed.
basics.x-tagline: Hard problems are welcome – the tougher the challenge, the more motivating it gets.
